mapper.select: SELECT A.RCP_NUMBER FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_INF A WHERE A.RCP_SEQ = REPLACE(#{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'GRP','') ORDER BY A.RCP_NUMBER ASC
